Academic References &

Complete APA 7th Edition bibliography supporting all nine academic modules. Includes foundational scholarship from Carol Dweck, Joseph Luft & Harry Ingham, Albert Mehrabian, Daniel Goleman, Paul MacLean, and the Emily Post Institute.

Chapter 01 • Introduction to Professional Skills & Johari WindowOpen Primary Source

Dweck, C. S. (2006). Mindset: The New Psychology of Success. Random House.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Explains how shifting from a fixed mindset to a growth mindset allows individuals to view failure as essential feedback, fostering lifelong resilience and adaptability in high-pressure workplaces.
Chapter 01 • Introduction to Professional Skills & Johari WindowOpen Primary Source

Luft, J., & Ingham, H. (1955). The Johari Window: A Graphic Model of Interpersonal Awareness. Proceedings of the Western Training Laboratory in Group Development.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Pioneers the four-quadrant matrix (Open, Blind, Hidden, Unknown) used globally in organizational psychology to systematically reduce blind spots and expand mutual trust through reciprocal feedback.
Chapter 02 • Portfolio Management & Engineering Your Digital BlueprintOpen Primary Source

Burnett, B., & Evans, D. (2016). Designing Your Life: How to Build a Well-Lived, Joyful Life. Knopf / Stanford d.school.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Demonstrates how design thinking principles (prototyping, iterative reframing, and active curation) are applied to personal career architecture and portfolio evolution.
Chapter 02 • Portfolio Management & Engineering Your Digital BlueprintOpen Primary Source

Zubizarreta, J. (2009). The Learning Portfolio: Reflective Practice for Improving Student Learning. Jossey-Bass.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Establishes that 'context is king' in academic assessment portfolios, proving that reflective meta-analysis of artefacts creates significantly deeper retention than uncontextualized project displays.
Chapter 03 • Job Interviews & Mock Interview SkillsOpen Primary Source

Mehrabian, A. (1971). Silent Messages: Implicit Communication of Emotions and Attitudes. Wadsworth Publishing.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Formulates the 7-38-55 communication rule during emotionally laden messages: 55% body language, 38% paralanguage/tone, and 7% literal spoken words, emphasizing bodily presence during job interviews.
Chapter 03 • Job Interviews & Mock Interview SkillsOpen Primary Source

Yate, M. (2020). Knock 'em Dead: The Ultimate Job Search Guide. Adams Media.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Deconstructs the candidate evaluation criteria: Why are you here? What can you do for us? and What kind of person are you?, alongside the behavioral STAR formula.
Chapter 04 • CV Writing & Career DocumentsOpen Primary Source

Innes, J. (2016). The CV Book: Your Definitive Guide to Writing the Perfect CV. Pearson Education.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Provides granular structural requirements for modern hybrid and chronological CV formats, including ATS parsing mechanics, action verbs, and metric-based accomplishments.
Chapter 05 • Speaking Skills & Effective MeetingsOpen Primary Source

Cutts, M. (2020). Oxford Guide to Plain English (5th ed.). Oxford University Press.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Details the 7 C's of professional communication (Clear, Concise, Concrete, Correct, Coherent, Complete, Courteous) and meeting facilitation protocols.
Chapter 06 • Professional Email & Online EtiquetteOpen Primary Source

Schwalbe, W., & Shipley, D. (2017). Send: Why People Email So Badly and How to Do It Better. Knopf Doubleday.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Defines digital netiquette, recipient field boundaries (To vs. Cc vs. Bcc), tone calibration, subject line syntax, and executive sign-off structures.
Chapter 07 • Telephone Etiquette & Customer ServiceOpen Primary Source

Evenson, R. (2011). Powerful Phrases for Effective Customer Service. AMACOM.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Introduces the 5 Steps to Telephone Excellence and the HEAT/LAST de-escalation framework for diffusing distressed or aggressive stakeholders.
Chapter 08 • Emotional Intelligence & Brain DynamicsOpen Primary Source

Goleman, D. (1995). Emotional Intelligence: Why It Can Matter More Than IQ. Bantam Books.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Establishes the neurobiology of the Amygdala Hijack and proves that Emotional Quotient (EQ) is the predominant predictor of executive durability and team cohesion.
Chapter 08 • Emotional Intelligence & Brain DynamicsOpen Primary Source

MacLean, P. D. (1990). The Triune Brain in Evolution: Role in Paleocerebral Functions. Plenum Press.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:Maps out the evolutionary architecture of human cognition: Reptilian Complex (survival), Limbic System (emotion), and Neocortex (prefrontal executive command).
Chapter 09 • Dining Etiquette & Table MannersOpen Primary Source

Post, L., & Post, D. (2022). Emily Post's Etiquette: The Centennial Edition. Ten Speed Press.

Pedagogical Contribution & Coursework Relevance:The definitive standard for formal diplomatic and corporate dining: Outside-In cutlery progression, silent utensil signaling, and executive social etiquette.
